q2_gaps: an intensifier modifying a spatial preposition ("right behind") — the only defined mechanism is the CamelCase join of a multi-word preposition, and "right" is a degree adverb rather than part of the preposition, so the intensifier has no carrier of its own

an institutional bare-noun locative frame ("in class") on a bare position clause — the clause mints no event, so there is no Location slot, and LocatedIn is defined as containment in a place rather than in an activity or institution
notes: The bare position clause correctly mints no event for "sat" and wraps both position atoms in Past, with the non-containment preposition kept entity-attached, exactly as "Where a THING is" prescribes. RightBehind is read here as covered by the multi-word entity-attached preposition convention (AcrossTheLaneFrom), but a strict reading of "the preposition actually used" would give Behind and leave "right" unrepresented.
